title: Article View Distribution
scenario: Identify articles in the Top 10% of total views per category.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, category_id INT), page_views (article_id INT, views_count INT)
correctQuery: SELECT article_id FROM (SELECT article_id, PERCENT_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY SUM(views_count) DESC) as pr FROM articles JOIN page_views USING (article_id) GROUP BY article_id, category_id) t WHERE pr <= 0.1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, category_id INT); CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, views_count INT);
